title: Materials Around Us
text:
Materials have different textures. Wood is hard and smooth. Cotton is soft and warm. Sand is rough, but glass is smooth and cold.

My grandmother has a wool sweater. It is very warm in winter. The sweater is a little itchy, but I like its bright color. Her chair is made of leather.

questions.text: What kind of texture is sand?
What is the grandmother's sweater made of?
Which material would be best for a warm winter coat?
Which material would feel cold when you touch it?

vocabulary.definition: not hard; easy to press or touch
flat and even, with no rough parts
a little hot, but not too hot
not smooth; it feels uneven when you touch it

paragraph_translations: Los materiales tienen texturas diferentes. La madera es dura y lisa. El algodón es suave y cálido. La arena es áspera, pero el vidrio es liso y frío.
Mi abuela tiene un suéter de lana. Es muy cálido en invierno. El suéter pica un poco, pero me gusta su color brillante. Su silla está hecha de cuero.
